shared_context.goal: Persist payroll snapshots in database and allow users to use frozen snapshot data instead of live Venus/Millware data.
shared_context.storage_decision: Use app-owned SQLite database at data/payroll_snapshot.db by default; schema is portable to SQL Server if centralized storage is required.
shared_context.compatibility_rule: Keep /api/payroll response shape compatible with existing PayrollReport, export, automation, and reset flows.
shared_context.conflict_policy: Inspect dirty diffs before editing and never overwrite unrelated uncommitted changes.
